## About RigGamer

RigGamer is an independent gaming media focused on free-to-play PC and mobile games.
All reviews are written by players with verified hours. The RigGamer score is /10:
Gameplay/2 + F2P/2 + Monetization/2 + Progression/2 + Stability/1 + Community/1.
No pay-to-review. No sponsored scores.
